title: Everything Claude Code launches open-source AI developer #anthropic #hackathon #aidevelopment
description: Afan Mustafa open-sourced Everything Claude Code, a comprehensive AI development setup with 181 skills, 47 sub-agents, and 79 commands. This system transforms Claude into a multi-functional developer team, enabling tasks like security scanning, memory optimization, and learning from past sessions. The toolkit supports multiple AI platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Encode, and Gemini, streamlining the creation, review, and improvement of AI products. Built during 10 months of real product work, it helped win the Anthropic Hackathon grand prize by launching a startup in just 8 hours. Everything Claude Code simplifies advanced AI workflows, making development more repeatable and organized for developers and startups focused on building reliable intelligent systems. #EverythingClaudeCode #AfanMustafa #AnthropicHackathon #ClaudeAI #AIworkflow #AIdevelopment #ClaudeCode #CursorAI #OpenSourceAI #AItools #GeminiAI #Codex #Encode #AIstartup #ArtificialIntelligence
